translations.web: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.
translations.bsb: As dead flies bring a stench to the perfumer’s oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.
translations.kjv: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
